details: Bitcoin experienced a sharp decline on Monday morning, falling below $77,000 before a slight recovery, leading to approximately $527 million in liquidations across the network. This downturn is attributed to a slump in Asian Pacific stock markets, notably South Korea's KOSPI index, and rising geopolitical tensions, including discussions around potential airstrikes against Iran. Concerns over the US bond market and accelerating inflation are also weighing on risk assets.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $77,000 Amid Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Concerns

details: Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have witnessed over $10 billion in outflows since the release of the latest U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) data on May 13. This development has significantly impacted market sentiment, causing it to drop from 87% to 45%, while the 30-year U.S. Treasury yield increased.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Over $10 Billion in Outflows Following CPI Data

details: Binance Research has identified four key on-chain signals indicating a tightening Bitcoin supply and exhausted selling pressure. Nearly 60% of Bitcoin's supply has remained unmoved for over a year, and exchange balances have reached a six-year low, with about 500,000 BTC leaving exchanges. Short-term holders are also beginning to rebuild unrealized gains.
title: Binance Research: Tightening Bitcoin Supply & Exhausted Selling Pressure

details: The Kingdom of Bhutan has publicly denied earlier reports of a $1 billion Bitcoin liquidation, challenging assumptions about sovereign selling pressure. This denial removes approximately 12,812 BTC from the perceived near-term supply overhang, potentially easing downward pressure on Bitcoin's price.
title: Bhutan Denies $1 Billion Bitcoin Liquidation, Easing Supply Concerns

details: Jump Crypto's Firedancer validator client has successfully entered production on the Solana mainnet, marking the first time a second independent validator implementation has reached this stage on the network. This significant milestone enhances Solana's network resilience and introduces crucial client diversity.
title: Solana's Firedancer Validator Client Enters Mainnet Production

details: A major Ethereum long position on Hyperliquid, totaling 114,000 ETH (valued at $259 million), is currently facing an unrealized loss of $10 million to $17.5 million as the price of ETH declined. The position was established at an average price of approximately $2,268.
title: Hyperliquid's Largest ETH Long Position Faces Significant Floating Loss

details: Japanese financial powerhouses SBI and Rakuten are reportedly developing their own in-house crypto investment trusts. This move indicates a growing institutional appetite and increasing adoption of digital assets within Japan's financial sector.
title: Japan's SBI and Rakuten Developing In-House Crypto Investment Trusts

details: Bitcoin's social sentiment has reached a yearly high following the landmark committee approval of the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act. The bill was advanced by the US Senate Banking Committee with a 15-9 bipartisan vote, moving it closer to a full Senate vote.
title: Bitcoin Social Sentiment Soars as CLARITY Act Advances in US Senate

details: The tokenized Real World Asset (RWA) market has surged to $34.5 billion, reflecting a remarkable 100% year-over-year growth. This expansion is largely driven by increasing institutional inflows into the sector.
title: Tokenized Real World Asset (RWA) Market Hits $34.5 Billion
